question.text: Navya Agritech (FPE — Section 8 Company, smallholder farmer tech) plans to raise EQUITY on NSE SSE and list debt securities separately. Ms. Sunita Patil (SIA) is asked to confirm the listing boards applicable. Per Section 3.3.1 of Chapter 3, FPEs shall list their securities on:

answer.text: Debt securities on the main board; equity securities on the main board OR SME platform (NSE-EMERGE/BSE SME) OR Innovators Growth Platform
Only the Innovators Growth Platform (IGP), regardless of security type
Only the SSE board — FPEs are not permitted to use Main Board or SME

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 3.3.1 states: 'For Profit Enterprises (FPEs) shall list their securities on their appropriate existing boards of stock exchanges. For example, debt securities shall be listed on the main boards, while equity securities shall either be listed on the main board (NSE/BSE), or on the SME platform (NSE-EMERGE/BSE SME) or Innovators Growth Platform (IGP).' SSE is the registration/disclosure platform; the listing board is the existing exchange platform. The Trap: Option A restricts to IGP only (wrong — it's one of three options for equity). Option C wrongly says FPEs cannot use Main Board (they can and do). Option D narrows to one SME limb. Cross-Exam Context: XII (SMF) Ch 1 covers NSE/BSE structure. III-A (Compliance) covers Main Board vs SME vs IGP listing requirements. XV (RA) values companies across all three. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Before drafting the SIA assurance, confirm which board the FPE will list on — the Main Board has stricter continuous disclosure (LODR Reg 33 quarterly), SME has relaxed timelines, IGP has differentiated voting rights allowed. Your attestation scope should align with the issuer's chosen board's LODR regime.
